name: Lying Figure-Four Stretch
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with both knees bent and feet planted flat.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh just above the knee, letting the crossed knee open outward.
Clasp the back of your uncrossed thigh and draw it toward you until the glute on the crossed side stretches.
Hold the stretch while breathing slowly and steadily on one side, then release gently and switch legs.
tips: Keep your head, shoulders, and tailbone resting comfortably on the floor rather than straining your neck upward.
Flex the foot of your crossed leg lightly to keep your knee joint aligned.
